title: Utah Boat and Jet Ski Rentals

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: The extra large MasterCraft X-30 performance boat rental allows you to shape the wakes to anyone’s individual water sport preferences. Try wakeboarding the water into submission at dawn. Then, dial the wakes into a tsunami for some wakesurfing or tubing. Do a boat tour across the countless lakes Utah has to offer at midday and get some lunch. Then, crank the X-30 wakeboard boat up for a friendly wakeskating competition. Finish the day with some glassy water slalom skiing. The X-30 ski boat rental has the hull to handle it all; plus the new Gen2 Surf system which creates monster surf waves! services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: We are your official provider of quality Utah Jet Ski Rentals in the state and have four different models of newer jet skis to choose from! We offer many new Sea-Doo models. Choose from 1300cc models going up to 300hp supercharged engine waverunners with enough power and speed to pull up double skis, wake boarders, kneeboards, tubes, air chairs, and wakeskates. With a four-stroke engine, being well maintained you will not have to worry about mechanical failures while on your boating vacation. These sea-doo rentals allow up to 3 persons to ride on them, with a top speed of 50 - 75 mph depending on weight, location, water conditions, and jet ski model you choose. Utah Jet Skis is the best
